reddit.title: Exciting Updates on Water Mechanics in Provincia!
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to how water interacts with the terrain in Provincia. The new system allows for more realistic water behavior without freezing your game. Check out the details of these changes and how they enhance gameplay: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits

steam.title: New Water Mechanics Update!
steam.body: We're excited to announce an update to the water mechanics in Provincia!
